title: Deputy Manager - Quality (Incoming)
description:
**Job Description**
The Deputy Manager - Incoming Quality is responsible for ensuring the quality and compliance of incoming raw materials, sheet metal parts, electrical components, busbars, switchgear, and bought-out items used in the manufacturing of electrical switchboards and IEC 60947 products. The role involves supplier quality management, incoming inspection, customer and audit support, team leadership, and driving continuous improvement initiatives while ensuring compliance with ISO 9001 and applicable IEC standards.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead Incoming Quality Control (IQC) activities and ensure conformity of incoming materials to specifications and standards.
* Develop and implement inspection plans, sampling plans, and quality control procedures.
* Manage supplier quality performance, supplier audits, NCRs, and corrective actions.
* Ensure compliance with ISO 9001, IEC 60947, IEC 61439, and customer requirements.
* Analyze supplier defects and drive root cause analysis using 8D, 5 Why, and CAPA methodologies.
* Coordinate with Procurement, Engineering, Production, and Suppliers to resolve quality issues.
* Lead and develop the incoming quality team to achieve quality objectives.
* Support customer audits, certification audits, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Monitor quality KPIs including Supplier PPM, Incoming Rejection Rate, NCR Closure, and Cost of Poor Quality.

**Qualifications**

* Diploma/BE/B.Tech, preferably in Electrical Engineering.
* 6+ years of relevant experience in the Quality department within the electrical switchgear/switchboard industry.
* Proficiency in MS Office applications (Excel, Word, and PowerPoint), ERP systems, and technical tools such as SPC, SOC, and other quality tools.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.

title: Assistant Director of Food And Beverage
description:
**About the University:**

O.P. Jindal Global University (JGU) is a multi-disciplinary and research oriented university founded in 2009. JGU is a non-profit global and research focused university and appoints faculty members from India and different parts of the world with outstanding academic qualifications and experience.

With over 16,000 students and 1100+ full time faculty members, studying and living on a fully residential campus, JGU's twelve schools focus on Law, Business & Management, International Affairs, Public Policy, Liberal Arts & Humanities, Journalism, Art & Architecture, Banking & Finance, Environment & Sustainability, Psychology & Counselling, Languages & Literature and Public Health & Human Development.

**KRAs for Senior GM/ Deputy Director -Office of Food Services and Outlets**

1. **Food Quality & Safety:**
   Ensure that all food served to students and at VVIP events meets the highest standards of hygiene, nutrition, and safety. Regularly monitor kitchen and outlet operations to maintain compliance with food safety regulations and University guidelines.
2. **Menu Planning & Management:**
   Review and update menus for student dining and events. Ensure that menus are balanced, appealing, culturally appropriate, and suited to the preferences and dietary needs of the students.
3. **Student Dining Operations:**
   Oversee the daily functioning of student dining facilities to ensure meals are served on time and in a professional manner. Monitor service quality, cleanliness, and student satisfaction, and take corrective actions where needed.
4. **VVIP Events Catering:**
   Plan and manage food arrangements for VVIP events, ensuring smooth execution, professional presentation, and high-quality service. Coordinate with the Sodexo team to meet University standards.
5. **Outlet Management:**
   Ensure the outlets are functioning efficiently, cleanliness is maintained, adhere to SOPs, being compliant and deliver hygienic and quality food items to the users.
6. **Vendor Management:**
   Manage and evaluate the performance of all vendors related to maintenance and services in the food department. Ensure timely execution, service quality, and adherence to the agreed terms.
7. **Financial Oversight & Cost Control:**
   Monitor budgets and expenses for student dining, events, and pantries. Implement cost control measures, reduce wastage, and ensure that operations remain financially efficient without compromising quality.
8. **Student & Guest Feedback:**
   Monitor feedback systems to gather inputs from students. Address complaints if any, promptly, identify areas for improvement, and implement changes to enhance service quality and satisfaction.
9. **Team Leadership & Training**
   : Lead, mentor, and train your team members to ensure they are skilled, remain motivated, and always follow professional service standards.
10. **Sustainability & Waste Management:**
    Introduce and monitor initiatives to reduce food wastage, promote eco-friendly practices, and implement sustainable operations across all food services, events, and outlets.
11. **Audit & Reporting: Conduct**
    regular audits of student dining, pantries, and outlets to ensure compliance with university standards. Prepare and submit detailed reports to the HOD, highlighting performance, challenges, and improvement plans.

**Key Deliverables**

* High student and faculty satisfaction ratings on dining services.
* Efficient cost control and achievement of budgeted financial targets.
* Strong vendor network ensuring quality and timely supply.
* Enhanced reputation of the University’s F&B services through quality, innovation, and professionalism.
* Successful execution of high-profile events with exceptional catering services.

**Experience & Qualification:**

Bachelor’s degree in Hospitality Management, Hotel Management, Food & Beverage Management, or related field.

20+ years of experience in food & beverage operations, preferably in an institutional or hospitality setting.

Strong knowledge of food safety, hygiene regulations, and kitchen management.

title: Engineer cum shift In-charge
description:
**Company Description**
Aarti Green Tech Ltd is a growing organization focused on sustainable industrial solutions and environmentally responsible manufacturing practices. The company aims to integrate green technologies into its operations, emphasizing energy efficiency, waste reduction, and compliance with environmental standards. With a commitment to innovation and operational excellence, Aarti Green Tech Ltd offers opportunities for engineering professionals to contribute to modern, eco-conscious production systems. Team members are encouraged to take ownership of processes, support continuous improvement, and uphold high standards of safety and quality. The company provides a structured work environment with scope for professional development and advancement.

**Job Purpose**

To ensure safe, efficient, and uninterrupted operation of the metal scrap shredding and baling press plant during the assigned shift. The role involves managing shift manpower, monitoring equipment performance, coordinating with the maintenance team, achieving production targets, maintaining quality standards, and ensuring compliance with safety and environmental requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Plant Operations & Production**

* Supervise day-to-day shift operations of the metal scrap shredding plant, baling presses, scrap feeding systems, conveyors, material handling equipment, and associated machinery.
* Ensure achievement of shift-wise production targets while maintaining operational efficiency and product quality.
* Monitor the performance of shredders, baling presses, conveyors, hydraulic systems, and other critical equipment.
* Ensure proper feeding of scrap material and smooth flow of material through the production process.
* Coordinate the operation of material handling equipment, including excavators, pay loaders, and other mobile equipment, as required.
* Minimize equipment downtime, production losses, material spillage, and operational bottlenecks.
* Ensure proper segregation, processing, and storage of scrap and shredded material as per the prescribed specifications.

**Manpower Management**

* Allocate duties to operators, helpers, fitters, riggers, gas cutters, and other shift personnel.
* Ensure adequate manpower availability and effective utilization during the assigned shift.
* Monitor employee attendance, discipline, punctuality, and adherence to shift schedules.
* Provide on-the-job guidance to operators and helpers to improve productivity and operational safety.
* Ensure proper shift handover, including production figures, equipment status, breakdowns, pending jobs, and safety-related observations.

**Equipment Monitoring & Maintenance Coordination**

* Monitor equipment operating parameters, including motor load, hydraulic pressure, temperature, vibration, abnormal noise, and conveyor performance.
* Identify equipment abnormalities and coordinate with the electrical and mechanical maintenance teams for timely corrective action.
* Ensure that routine inspections, cleaning, lubrication, and preventive maintenance activities are carried out as per the prescribed schedule.
* Report breakdowns promptly and maintain records of downtime, breakdown causes, and corrective actions.
* Ensure that equipment is not operated under unsafe conditions or without required safety guards and interlocks.
* Coordinate maintenance activities during shutdowns and ensure safe restoration of equipment after maintenance.

**Safety, Health & Environment**

* Ensure strict compliance with plant safety procedures, SOPs, permit-to-work requirements, and applicable statutory regulations.
* Conduct toolbox talks and shift safety briefings, and ensure that employees use the prescribed personal protective equipment (PPE).
* Ensure safe handling of scrap, including the identification of gas cylinders, closed containers, hazardous materials, and other potentially dangerous items.
* Ensure that shredders and associated equipment are operated only when required safety systems, including water sprinklers and dust-control arrangements, are functional.
* Prevent unauthorized entry into operational areas and ensure safe movement of vehicles, equipment, and personnel.
* Report accidents, near misses, unsafe acts, and unsafe conditions immediately and support incident investigations.
* Maintain housekeeping standards and ensure proper disposal and management of process residue and waste.

**Quality & Process Control**

* Ensure that shredded and baled scrap meets the prescribed customer and process specifications.
* Monitor bale size, density, quality, and consistency, wherever applicable.
* Minimize contamination, foreign materials, and process-related material losses.
* Coordinate with the quality team and management to resolve process and material-quality issues.

**Reporting & Documentation**

* Maintain shift-wise records of production, equipment utilization, downtime, manpower deployment, and material movement.
* Prepare shift production reports and submit them to the reporting manager within the prescribed timeline.
* Maintain equipment inspection checklists, breakdown reports, safety observations, and shift handover records.
* Report abnormal consumption of electricity, hydraulic oil, lubricants, and other consumables.
* Highlight operational constraints and recommend corrective and preventive measures for improving productivity.

**Qualifications**

* Diploma or Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Production, or a related engineering discipline.
* Candidates with relevant technical qualifications and substantial experience in metal scrap processing may also be considered.

**Experience**

* Preferably
  **5–8 years of experience**
  in industrial plant operations, scrap processing, metal shredding, baling presses, steel plants, recycling facilities, or heavy engineering industries.
* Experience in handling shift operations, hydraulic baling presses, shredders, conveyors, and material handling equipment will be preferred.
* Experience in manpower supervision, breakdown coordination, and industrial safety is essential.

title: Operations Manager
description:
Company Name: Eye-Q Eye Hospitals
  
  
Job Title: Operations Manager
  
  
Job Description:
  
The Operations Manager at Eye-Q Eye Hospitals will oversee the daily operations of our healthcare facilities, ensuring efficient and high-quality patient care. This role requires a strong leader who can manage multiple teams and collaborate effectively with various departments. The Operations Manager will be responsible for optimizing operational processes, improving patient flow, and enhancing overall service delivery. In addition to managing budgets and resources, this position will also involve strategic planning to support the hospital's growth and compliance with healthcare regulations.
  
  
Key Responsibilities:
  
- Manage day-to-day operations of Eye-Q Eye Hospitals, ensuring efficiency and productivity.
  
- Develop and implement operational policies and procedures to enhance service quality and patient satisfaction.
  
- Monitor performance metrics and KPIs to assess operational effectiveness and identify areas for improvement.
  
- Collaborate with medical staff and department heads to streamline processes and improve patient care.
  
- Manage budgets, resources, and staffing to optimize operational performance.
  
- Ensure compliance with healthcare regulations, standards, and best practices.
  
- Provide leadership and support to the operations team, fostering a positive work environment.
  
- Oversee patient flow and manage the scheduling process to minimize wait times and enhance patient experience.
  
- Conduct regular audits and assessments to ensure quality control and continuous improvement.
  
  
Skills and Tools Required:
  
- Proven experience in operations management within a healthcare setting.
  
- Strong leadership and team management skills.
  
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a focus on building relationships.
  
- Proficiency in healthcare management software and electronic health records (EHR) systems.
  
- Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  
- Knowledge of healthcare regulations and compliance standards.
  
- Ability to manage budgets and optimize resource allocation.
  
- Familiarity with process improvement methodologies, such as Lean or Six Sigma.
  
- Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and data analysis tools.
  
  
Qualifications:
  
- Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Administration, Business Management, or a related field (Master's degree preferred).
  
- Minimum 5 years of experience in operations management, preferably in a healthcare environment.
  
- Strong understanding of patient care processes and healthcare delivery systems.

title: FLM (Production shift supervisor)
description:
**Company Description**
Continental is a leading tire manufacturer and industrial specialist. Founded in 1871, the company generated revenue of 19.7 billion euros in 2025 and currently employs around 78,000 people in 54 countries and markets.
  
  
The ContiTech business area is one of the world's leading material experts for industrial applications. That means: We develop products and solutions that are used in many areas of your everyday life – for example in agriculture, on railways and roads, in the air, above and below ground, in industrial environments, as well as in the food and furniture industries. With around 20,000 employees at more than 60 locations worldwide and revenue of around 6.0 billion euros (2025), we operate as a global industrial partner with a focus on Asia, Europe, North and South America.
  
  
The spin-off of ContiTech is currently being considered – your chance to actively help shape something new.
  
  
We are ready to get started with you!
  
  
**Job Description**
The position holder is responsible for the implementation & application of sustainable & optimized systems and processes in the area of responsibility in order to achieve relevant operational targets (e.g. quality, output, cost, time). The position holder is responsible for the safety, health and development of people reporting to the position. By doing so, he/she takes into account all customer-relevant regulations and laws. Furthermore, the position holder ensures that processes are carried out with the standard specifications (based on key performance indicators (KPI)) and is responsible for the availability / provision of resources (such as people, machines and production space).
  
  
**Task areas**
**Main tasks\***
**Leadership**

* Support in setting the link between plant/company goals & strategy and the shop floor with support of operations unit/ production management team (shared responsibility)
* Show presence on the shop floor and act as role model & coach for shop floor employees (full responsibility)
* Enable a values based and healthy leadership culture

**Work Organization & Coordination (Planning / Scheduling)**

* Execute regular shop floor meetings to communicate daily KPI's, set priorities, define measures supported by employees
* Secure the observance of standard work instructions and processes
* Plan variable head count to secure the full productivity under consideration of the actual orderbook and manage personnel availabilities (e.g. vacation, sickness, training...) to ensure daily production
* Monitor machine capacity to ensure the daily production taking into account cost, quality and order situation
* Drive and implement improvements for optimization of material flow, monitor and report the targets of efficiency

**Quality Management & Continuous Improvement**

* Promote "Quality First" and improvement culture on the shop floor, encourage and challenge employee's participation in continuous improvement processes
* Drive proactively lessons learned and best practice sharing
* Ensure implementation of quality standards and apply quality methods to increase quality performance
* Support systematic implementation of Continental Business System CBS methods & tools
* Implementation and carry out of improvements measurements for continous reduction of manufacturing costs & process improvement
* Use audit & quality review results (internal, external, 5S, ...) to set up sustainable optimizations

and ensure implementation
  
  

* Motivate and support employees to share their ideas for improvement, e.g. by using Conti Idea Management CIM or Cost Saving Program CSP

**Production Performance / Productivity**

* Continuously track the actual state against defined target state by using Key Performance Indicators (KPIs, e.g. output, scrap/waste, productivity) under consideration of budget / standard
* Evaluate complex problems detected in his area of responsibility (either through target state/ KPI deviations or other means) & escalated by shop floor operators as defined in the standards, decide on escalation upwards in hierarchy depending on magnitude of problem, steer systematic problem solving processes until solution is found, present/communicate solution and adjust standard/ target state accordingly

**Legal, Compliance**

* Implement and ensure compliance with established internal/ external policies, rules, guidelines and procedures (e.g. technical cleanliness, ISO...)
* Support and run audit process (internal/external) if required

**People Development & Talent Management**

* Ensure systematic & continuous qualification /competency development of employees, i.e. ensure that a qualification matrix exists & create individual development plans
* Support a culture of life-long learning and provide learning opportunities for employees
* Decide on suitable development measures for employees, document participation and evaluate effectiveness
* Perform annual face-to-face employee dialogues to discuss performance, potential and development of employees, provide effective feedback & address poor performance
* Ensure proper onboarding/ integration of new employees

Environment, Safety, Health
  
  

* Create a culture of safety and health through leadership & act as role model
* Ensure application of ESH regulations and management methods & tools (e.g. 5S systematic) as well as engagement of people
* Enhance safety performance by tracking & reporting safety incidents (e.g. accidents, ergonomic, behavior-based, process-related; layout related incidents), remove hazards, support evaluation of ESH measures effectiveness & implement best practices

**Qualifications**

* Graduate in mechanical Engineering/Chemical engineering/Rubber technology
* 5-8 years of experience in production coordination, manufacturing operations, or a related role
* Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to prioritize multiple tasks
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
* Proficiency in MS Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)
* Detail-oriented mindset with strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
* Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced manufacturing environment
* Knowledge of inventory management and material planning processes
* Familiarity with quality assurance principles and production standards
* Preferred: Experience with specific ERP platforms used in manufacturing
* Preferred: Knowledge of lean manufacturing or continuous improvement methodologies
* Note: Candidates from Air springs or Rubber Components manufacturing are preferred

**Additional Information**
**Knowledge field**
**Level\***
(B/A/E)
  
  
SAP - PP module >Advanced
  
  
Knowledge in planning & organizing, Line balancing >Advanced
  
  
Technological skills (e.g. basic digital skills, advanced IT skills) >Basic
  
  
Technical knowledge (e.g. advanced knowledge of relevant technology, processes and products in own area; basic knowledge for neighbouring areas) >Advanced
  
  
Systematic problem solving methods (e.g. PDCA, A-3 reports, …) >Basic
  
  
ESH regulations (safety regulations, safety equipment, hazardous materials, ...) and other legal >Advanced
  
  
Leadership methods & techniques (e.g. techniques for coaching, providing/receiving feedback, leading change..) >Advanced
  
  
Performance management techniques (e.g. knowledge of reporting progress and relevant KPIs (e.g. OEE, FPY, Scrap)) >Advanced
  
  
Communication skills (delegating tasks, conflict resolution) >Expert
  
  
Quality Methods (e.g. Jidoka /Poke Yoke, Yokoten) >Basic
  
  
Continuous improvement and CBS methods (e.g. knowledge of lean principles, methods and tools (Flow, 5S,TPM, etc.)) >Basic
  
  
Visual management methods (e.g. tools for visualization of e.g. KPI's, problems, improvements on the shop floor (shop floor boards) >Basic

title: Students Experience Manager
description:
**Job Description**
**Position**
: Senior Manager - Student Experience
  
  
**Department:**
Student Housing / Student Experience
  
  
**Reporting To**
: Site Head / Head - Student Housing
  
  
**Location**
: University Residential Campus
  
  
**Employment Type**
: Full-Time
  
  
**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**

* Position Purpose

The Senior Manager - Student Experience will be responsible for driving student experience, residential quality, student engagement, student support coordination, feedback management, grievance resolution, and continuous improvement across the student housing environment.
  
  
The role will serve as an important link between students, Wardens, Student Housing Operations, University stakeholders, support teams, and service partners, ensuring that student concerns are identified proactively, addressed professionally, and converted into measurable service improvements.
  
  
The position requires strong experience in student engagement, customer experience, residential operations, quality management, community management, service excellence, or institutional/student affairs.
  
  
**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**

* Key Responsibilities
* Student Experience & Quality

Own and drive the overall student experience and quality agenda across student residences.
  
  
Establish and monitor quality standards for student housing services.
  
  
Conduct regular student interactions, floor visits, feedback sessions, and quality audits.
  
  
Identify recurring student concerns and develop corrective and preventive action plans.
  
  
Monitor service quality across Housekeeping, Security, Maintenance, Food Services, and other residential services.
  
  
Ensure student-facing services are delivered consistently across all residential blocks.
  
  
Develop and implement initiatives to improve student satisfaction, participation, and engagement.
  
  
**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**

* Student Feedback & Grievance Management

Establish a structured mechanism for collecting and analysing student feedback.
  
  
Monitor student complaints, grievances, and escalations through designated systems.
  
  
Analyse complaints to identify root causes, recurring trends, and systemic gaps.
  
  
Coordinate with respective departments to ensure timely resolution.
  
  
Track escalated and sensitive cases until closure.
  
  
Prepare regular Student Experience / Quality Dashboards for senior management.
  
  
Ensure student concerns are handled with confidentiality, professionalism, and responsiveness.
  
  
**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**

* Student Engagement

Build strong and constructive relationships with students.
  
  
Conduct regular student forums, listening sessions, and engagement activities.
  
  
Work closely with Student Council and student representatives.
  
  
Create mechanisms through which students can safely provide feedback and suggestions.
  
  
Develop initiatives that promote a positive, inclusive, and respectful residential community.
  
  
Proactively identify emerging student concerns before they become major grievances.
  
  
**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**

* Quality Audits & Compliance

Conduct periodic quality audits of student residences.
  
  
Develop checklists and measurable quality parameters for residential services.
  
  
Monitor compliance with Student Housing SOPs and University policies.
  
  
Conduct surprise inspections and student experience audits.
  
  
Identify gaps and coordinate corrective actions with relevant functional teams.
  
  
Track closure of audit observations within agreed timelines.
  
  
**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**

* Data, Analytics & Continuous Improvement

Analyse student complaints, feedback, satisfaction scores, and service-performance data.
  
  
Identify trends by hostel/block, service category, and time period.
  
  
Develop actionable recommendations based on data.
  
  
Establish service-quality KPIs and track performance.
  
  
Drive continuous improvement initiatives based on student feedback and operational data.
  
  
Present key insights, risks, and recommendations to senior leadership.
  
  
**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**

* Cross-Functional Coordination

**Work Closely With**
Student Housing Operations
  
  
University Wardens
  
  
Student Support Teams
  
  
Security
  
  
Housekeeping
  
  
Engineering / Technical Services
  
  
University Medical Centre
  
  
University Departments
  
  
Ensure effective coordination for student-related issues requiring multi-functional intervention.
  
  
Coordinate referrals and follow-ups with appropriate support functions whenever specialised intervention is required. The role itself does not provide counselling or therapeutic services.
  
  
**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**

* Critical Incident & Sensitive Case Management

Support the Student Housing leadership team in handling sensitive and high-priority student cases.
  
  
Ensure timely identification, documentation, and escalation of cases involving student safety, conduct, or support concerns.
  
  
Coordinate with authorised University stakeholders and designated support teams for appropriate intervention.
  
  
Ensure proper documentation and follow-up.
  
  
Maintain strict confidentiality of sensitive student information.
  
  
Ensure all actions follow University policies and established protocols.
  
  
**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**

* Key Performance Indicators

Student Satisfaction / Experience Score
  
  
Reduction in recurring student complaints
  
  
Complaint resolution and closure timelines
  
  
Quality audit compliance
  
  
Student engagement levels
  
  
Feedback participation rate
  
  
Effectiveness of corrective and preventive actions
  
  
Student support referral coordination effectiveness
  
  
Reduction in repeat grievances
  
  
Quality of student communication and engagement
  
  
Timeliness and accuracy of management reporting
  
  
**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**

* Qualification & Experience

**Educational Qualification**
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Education, Student Affairs, Hospitality, Business Administration, Operations Management, Public Administration, Social Sciences, or a related discipline.
  
  
Additional qualifications or certifications in Customer Experience, Service Quality, Student Affairs Administration, Community Management, or Hospitality Operations will be advantageous.
  
  

* Professional Experience

8-12 years of relevant experience in one or more of the following:
  
  
University / Higher Education
  
  
Student Affairs / Student Services
  
  
Student Housing / Residential Operations
  
  
Student Experience & Engagement

title: Farm Manager Aquaculture
description:
**Company Description**

Affy Parenterals is a certified pharmaceutical manufacturing company based in Baddi, Himachal Pradesh, India, with over 28 years of experience in the pharmaceutical industry. The company operates multiple manufacturing units along with printing and packaging units, producing over 8,000 pharmaceutical brands for more than 1,000 customers worldwide. Affy specialises in a wide range of pharmaceutical formulations, focusing on delivering quality products at affordable prices. Key product categories include oncology, injectables, soft and hard gelatin capsules, tablets, nutraceuticals, and diagnostic solutions. Going forward, Affy Group is expanding its horizon into the Aquaculture & Agriculture Industry, leveraging its extensive manufacturing expertise to drive innovation and diversification.

**Position Overview**

We are seeking a highly skilled and dedicated Farm Manager to oversee our advanced aquaculture operations in Ujina, Haryana. This is a full-time, on-site role, located in Ujina, Haryana (District-Nuh), which is pivotal in managing the end-to-end production of Pangasius, Tilapia, Sea Bass, Shrimp, Rohu, and Scampi using cutting-edge technology, specifically In-Pond Raceway Systems (IPRS) and Recirculating Aquaculture Systems (RAS). The ideal candidate will be a hands-on leader with deep technical expertise in intensive fish farming, biological monitoring, and system maintenance.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Production Management: Oversee the complete lifecycle, from fingerling stocking and grading to harvesting and post-harvest logistics.
* System Oversight: Manage and optimise the daily operations of IPRS and RAS, ensuring peak efficiency of filtration, aeration, and water circulation components.
* Water Quality Monitoring: Conduct rigorous daily testing of water parameters (DO, pH, Ammonia, Nitrates, Temperature) and implement immediate corrective actions to maintain an optimal environment.
* Biosecurity & Health: Implement strict biosecurity protocols to prevent disease outbreaks. Diagnose fish health issues and manage feeding regimes to maximise Growth Rate (SGR) and minimise Food Conversion Ratio (FCR).
* Inventory & Data Logging: Maintain meticulous records of feed consumption, growth charts, mortality rates, and chemical usage. Manage procurement of farm inputs.
* Team Leadership: Supervise and train on-site farm labourers and technicians, ensuring a culture of safety and precision.
* Maintenance: Coordinate routine and emergency repairs for pumps, blowers, sensors, and backup power systems to ensure 24/7 operational continuity.

If you feel like you fit the role and are excited to take on this opportunity, please share your CV and a brief cover letter at - Email Address - anshika@affygroup.com, mentioning
*“Farm Manager - Aquaculture”*
in the subject line. We appreciate your interest in joining our team and will reach out to the shortlisted candidates.

title: Production Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 STAR KIDZ Footwear is part of Ojas Footwear India Pvt. Ltd., a leading manufacturer of kids’ footwear for ages 1 to 13, offering products for all children. The company manages well\-known brands including Star Kidz, Softride, and Scuba, recognized for quality, comfort, and innovative designs. Its success is driven by a strong mix of experienced professionals and emerging talent across design, development, production, quality control, sales, and customer service. STAR KIDZ Footwear provides a collaborative environment focused on continuous improvement and customer satisfaction, offering opportunities to contribute to a growing, dynamic business in the kids’ footwear segment.
   

  

**Role Description** 
 The Production Manager (PU machine) is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Bahadurgarh. This role oversees the end\-to\-end production process for kids’ footwear, ensuring that daily manufacturing targets are met while maintaining quality, safety, and cost efficiency. Responsibilities include planning and scheduling production runs, coordinating with design, procurement, and quality teams, and monitoring workflow on the shop floor. The Production Manager tracks material usage, manages inventory related to production, and addresses any operational bottlenecks or equipment issues to keep output on schedule. The role also involves leading and mentoring production staff, enforcing compliance with company standards and regulations, and implementing continuous improvement initiatives to optimize productivity and reduce waste.
   

  

  

**Qualifications**
* Demonstrated experience in production management or factory operations, preferably in footwear, apparel, or related manufacturing.
* Strong skills in production planning, scheduling, and resource allocation to meet daily and weekly output targets.
* Knowledge of quality control processes, safety standards, and compliance requirements in a manufacturing environment.
* Ability to manage and mentor shop\-floor teams, resolve operational issues, and foster a collaborative work culture.
* Comfort with using production reports, KPIs, and basic data analysis to drive decisions and process improvements.
* Effective communication and coordination skills for working with design, procurement, sales, and management teams.
* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Production Management, Industrial Engineering, Footwear Technology, or a related field is preferred.
* Experience with lean manufacturing, 5S, or other continuous improvement methodologies is an advantage.
* Ability to work on\-site in Bahadurgarh and adapt to a fast\-paced, growth\-oriented manufacturing setting.

title: Night Manager - Students Housing
description:
The Resident Night Manager will be responsible for the
 **overall management of student housing operations during the night shift** 
 , with primary accountability for
 **student safety, emergency response, and operational continuity** 
 .
 



  





 The position requires a strong
 **security and operations background** 
 and the ability to independently manage critical situations, lead night\-shift teams, coordinate with multiple support functions, and ensure strict adherence to Company / University policies and Student Housing SOPs.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Night Operations \& Student Safety** 



* Take overall responsibility for night\-time operations across assigned student residences.
* Conduct regular rounds of hostel buildings, common areas, entry/exit points and other critical areas.
* Ensure compliance with Student Housing policies, safety procedures and operational SOPs.
* Maintain a safe, secure and disciplined residential environment.



**2\. Incident \& Emergency Management** 



* Act as the senior on\-ground responder for significant night\-time incidents.
* Manage and coordinate response to:
* Medical emergencies
* Fire and life\-safety incidents
* Theft or suspected theft
* Security breaches
* Student conflicts and disturbances
* Unauthorized entry
* Property damage
* Missing/welfare\-related concerns
* Critical engineering or infrastructure failures
* Coordinate with Security, Wardens, Medical Centre, Engineering and University leadership.
* Ensure timely escalation, containment, documentation and follow\-up of incidents.



**4\. Student \& Conflict Management** 



* Maintain a professional, calm and approachable presence while dealing with students.
* Handle student concerns and conflicts with maturity and sensitivity.
* De\-escalate difficult situations and ensure student safety.
* Maintain confidentiality in sensitive student\-related matters.



**5\. Coordination with Technical Services** 



* Coordinate with the night Engineering / Technical Services team for critical issues relating to HVAC, electrical, plumbing, lifts, water supply, fire systems and other essential services.
* Ensure critical complaints are responded to within defined timelines.
* Escalate unresolved or high\-risk technical issues to the appropriate leadership.



**6\. Team Leadership** 



* Supervise and coordinate night\-shift Housekeeping and Technical Services personnel.
* Ensure manpower deployment as per approved roster.
* Monitor discipline, grooming, attendance and professional conduct.
* Conduct periodic surprise checks and operational audits.
* Ensure effective coordination among all night\-shift functions.



**7\. Reporting \& Handover** 



* Maintain a comprehensive Night Shift Operations \& Incident Log.
* Prepare daily night\-shift reports covering incidents, security observations, student concerns, emergencies and operational issues.
* Ensure complete handover of open and critical matters to the day team.
* Maintain accurate and confidential incident records.
